qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Proprietary VAM premium threaded connections qualified with global oil majors, but sub-hurdle multi-cycle ROIC (<12%) and cyclical price-taker status behind market leader Tenaris demonstrate lack of structural pricing power across cycles.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Post-restructuring manufacturer of seamless OCTG tubes; lacks structural pricing power across the energy cycle and trails market leader Tenaris, resulting in sub-hurdle multi-cycle ROIC.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-cycle ROIC consistently below 12% requirement, marred by repeated equity-diluting restructurings and mill closures. Earnings fluctuate violently with global drilling rig counts and OCTG spot pricing.
